content: The provided text is an extensive list of injury classifications based on the ICD-10 coding system. The ICD-10 Chapter XIX focuses on injuries, poisonings, and certain other consequences of external causes. It includes the following classifications: Head Injuries (S00-S09) S00: Superficial injuries of the head, including: S00.0: Superficial injury of the scalp. S00.1: Contusion of the eyelid and periocular area, commonly referred to as a black eye. S00.2: Other superficial injuries of the eyelid and periocular area. S00.3: Superficial injury of the nose. S00.4: Superficial injury of the ear. S00.5: Superficial injury of the lip and oral cavity. S00.7: Multiple superficial injuries of the head. S00.8: Superficial injury of other parts of the head. S00.9: Superficial injury of the head, unspecified. S01: Open wounds of the head. S02: Fractures of the skull and facial bones, including: S02.0: Fracture of the vault of the skull. S02.1: Fracture of the base of the skull. S02.2: Fracture of the nasal bones. S02.3: Fracture of the orbital floor. S02.4: Fracture of the malar and maxillary bones. S02.5: Fracture of a tooth. S02.6: Fracture of the mandible. S02.7: Multiple fractures involving the skull and facial bones. S02.8: Fractures of other skull and facial bones. S02.9: Fracture of the skull and facial bones, unspecified. S03: Dislocations, sprains, and strains of joints and ligaments of the head. S04: Injuries to cranial nerves, including: S04.0: Injury to the optic nerve and pathways. S04.1: Injury to the oculomotor nerve. S04.2: Injury to the trochlear nerve. S04.3: Injury to the trigeminal nerve. S04.4: Injury to the abducent nerve. S04.5: Injury to the facial nerve. S04.6: Injury to the acoustic nerve. S04.7: Injury to the accessory nerve. S04.8: Injury to other cranial nerves. S04.9: Injury to an unspecified cranial nerve. S05: Injuries to the eye and orbit, including: S05.0: Injury to the conjunctiva and corneal abrasion without foreign body. S05.1: Contusion of the eyeball and orbital tissues. S05.2: Ocular laceration and rupture with prolapse or loss of intraocular tissue. S05.3: Ocular laceration without prolapse or loss of intraocular tissue. S05.4: Penetrating wound of the orbit, with or without a foreign body. S05.5: Penetrating wound of the eyeball with a foreign body. S05.6: Penetrating wound of the eyeball without a foreign body. S05.7: Avulsion of the eye. S05.8: Other injuries of the eye and orbit. S05.9: Injury of the eye and orbit, unspecified. S06: Intracranial injuries, including: S06.0: Concussion. S06.1: Traumatic cerebral edema. S06.2: Diffuse brain injury, not otherwise specified (NOS). S06.3: Focal brain injury. S06.4: Epidural hemorrhage. S06.5: Traumatic subdural hemorrhage. S06.6: Traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage. S06.7: Intracranial injury with prolonged coma. S06.8: Other intracranial injuries. S06.9: Intracranial injury, unspecified. S07: Crushing injuries of the head. S08: Traumatic amputation of part of the head. S09: Other and unspecified injuries of the head. Neck Injuries (S10-S19) S10: Superficial injuries of the neck. S11: Open wounds of the neck. S12: Fractures of the neck, including: S12.0: Fracture of the first cervical vertebra. S12.1: Fracture of the second cervical vertebra. S12.2: Fracture of other specified cervical vertebrae. S12.7: Multiple fractures of the cervical spine. S12.8: Fracture of other parts of the neck. S12.9: Fracture of the neck, unspecified. S13: Dislocations, sprains, and strains of joints and ligaments at the neck level, including: S13.0: Traumatic rupture of a cervical intervertebral disc. S13.1: Dislocation of cervical vertebrae. S13.2: Dislocation of other and unspecified parts of the neck. S13.3: Multiple dislocations of the neck. S13.4: Sprain and strain of the cervical spine (e.g., whiplash injury). S13.5: Sprain and strain of the thyroid region. S13.6: Sprain and strain of joints and ligaments of other and unspecified parts of the neck. S14: Injuries to nerves and the spinal cord at the neck level, including: S14.0: Concussion and edema of the cervical spinal cord. S14.1: Other and unspecified injuries of the cervical spinal cord. S14.2: Injury to the nerve root of the cervical spine. S14.3: Injury to the brachial plexus. S14.4: Injury to peripheral nerves of the neck. S14.5: Injury to cervical sympathetic nerves. S14.6: Injury to other and unspecified nerves of the neck. S15: Injuries to blood vessels at the neck level. S16: Injuries to muscles and tendons at the neck level. S17: Crushing injuries of the neck. S18: Traumatic amputation at the neck level. S19: Other and unspecified injuries of the neck. This is a detailed breakdown of the ICD-10 injury classifications for the head and neck regions.
